method.latency: Full response body received; hash verification follows timer. Batch wall time includes verification.
method.percentile: Nearest-rank p95 on successful samples; no confidence interval or SLA inferred.
method.order: Variants sequential; workload order rotates across three repetitions. Docker main lab remains idle in background.
method.resources: Single = .5 CPU/256 MiB; two = 2 x .5 CPU/256 MiB; single-wide = 1 CPU/512 MiB; single-tight = .25 CPU/128 MiB. MongoDB/storage caps fixed.
method.scope: Authenticated loopback requests including gateway, scoped MongoDB sessions/catalogue/read activity, hashing and SeaweedFS replication 001. No physical data-centre claim.
